article.title: Refund of balance deposit.
article.content: When the copy of the record, except as aforesaid, has been transmitted to 1[the Supreme Court], the appellant may obtain a refund of the balance (if any) of the amount which he has deposited under rule 7.
article.html:
12Refund of balance deposit.

Order 45, Rule 12

When the copy of the record, except as aforesaid, has been transmitted to 1[the Supreme Court], the appellant may obtain a refund of the balance (if any) of the amount which he has deposited under rule 7.

1 Subs. by the A.O. 1950, for “His Majesty in Council”.
